rows.implementation_hypothesis: Keep PR/issue/commit provenance fields and require target-pass/base-fail replay before manifest inclusion.
rows.local_experiment: Baseline reproduction and exact certification attempts record reference_target and base_with_injected_tests subgates.
rows.mechanism: PR/issue-linked tasks with fail-to-pass tests as primary evaluation signal.
rows.why_it_might_help: Requires public problem context plus changed-test oracle, matching Sphinx/mypy history mining.

rows.implementation_hypothesis: Keep source-confidence, ambiguity, and leakage labels even when no paid LLM review is used.
rows.local_experiment: Manifest rows expose statement provenance and source confidence.
rows.mechanism: Human filtering for clear statements, correct tests, and solvability.
rows.why_it_might_help: Sphinx/mypy commit subjects can be thin; labels prevent overclaiming statement quality.

rows.implementation_hypothesis: Use version-aware uv profiles keyed by task time instead of one generic command.
rows.local_experiment: Sphinx and mypy adapters try bounded date-compatible profiles and record profile winners.
rows.mechanism: Automated issue/PR curation, environment setup, and reproducible execution images.
rows.why_it_might_help: Historical Sphinx/mypy failures are often environment/profile failures.

rows.implementation_hypothesis: Separate entry points from support oracle files and inject all target-commit oracle material into base.
rows.local_experiment: Mypy data-file adapter and Sphinx support-root metadata are evaluated in no-paid certification.
rows.mechanism: Programmatic sourcing, environment synthesis, state-differential oracle extraction, and QA.
rows.why_it_might_help: The local bottleneck is hidden oracle self-containment and deterministic target/base replay.

rows.implementation_hypothesis: Window manifests expose history pools and future holdouts separately, with selected IDs left empty.
rows.local_experiment: Corrected windows for both repos keep future_holdout_after_origin outside selector inputs.
rows.mechanism: Held-out/private partitions, human augmented specs, and contamination-resistant design.
rows.why_it_might_help: Rolling-origin windows must prevent future task IDs/outcomes from selector inputs.

rows.implementation_hypothesis: Synthetic reservoirs need separate source caps and predictive-value validation before release.
rows.local_experiment: Not used because real-history exact certification reached the target without synthetic tasks.
rows.mechanism: Synthetic tasks that break existing tests after constructing execution environments.
rows.why_it_might_help: Could add supply if repository history remains below threshold.
